name: CODEX: ORKS
description:
Orks are stronger than any human, with rippling muscles, maws full of yellowing fangs, and a natural toughness that allows them to shrug off all but the worst injuries. They are a terrifying foe to face, especially in large numbers. Bellowing mobs of Boyz surge forward, enthusiastically spraying bursts of gunfire, while ramshackle buggies, hurtling beast riders, and trundling walkers rush to get to grips with their foes. They are the most joyously anarchic and recklessly destructive force in the galaxy.

Codex: Orks is an essential supplement for anyone who wants to collect and play games of Warhammer 40,000 with these brutal and kunnin' warriors. Packed with warlike background material, photography of impressive armies, guidelines for growing and painting your collection, and the rules you'll need to field your mighty Waaagh!.

Inside this 176-page softcover book, you'll find:
– A full lore section with background material, historical notes, evocative artwork, a description of various units, and inspiring photography, giving you insight into Ork society
– A collecting section containing advice on building a thematic army and working towards detachments, with painting guides and tips about creating a themed battlefield
– A rules section with the army special rules, 15 detachments, and 54 datasheets you'll need to field your Orks as an effective fighting force on the tabletop
– A gatefold on both the front and back cover, featuring photography, a galactic map tracking the Orks across space, and an Inquisitorial report on Ork activity in various war zones

This book is presented in an easy-to-carry 185mm by 250mm softcover format with a removable slipcase.

Inside the back cover, you’ll find a unique code that will unlock the Orks faction in Warhammer 40,000: The App, including ongoing access to more free Orks content over time.
